records.title: Advances in Pre-trained Language Models for Domain-Specific Text Classification: A Systematic Review
records.reason: This is a systematic review of domain-specific text-classification models, not an LLM inference or serving optimization contribution.

records.title: Serving MoE Models on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices via Dynamic Expert Swapping
records.reason: The packet abstract describes an inference framework for constrained MoE serving and reports memory/latency benefits, so relevance is clear at abstract stage. The exact IEEE DOI full text was not retrievable; the accessible arXiv page is an earlier differently titled version, so its details cannot safely establish the packet version’s method/evaluation. Retain as borderline until the DOI version can be checked.

records.title: Get Experience from Practice: LLM Agents with Record & Replay
records.reason: The paper proposes recording and replaying LLM-agent experiences and states potential deployment-cost reduction, but the checked primary design/case-study sections do not provide measured model-call, token, latency, memory, or energy savings. The contribution is an agent workflow framework with unquantified serving-efficiency implications.

records.title: prompt4vis: prompting large language models with example mining for tabular data visualization
records.reason: Prompt4Vis filters schema fields and selects examples for a narrow text-to-visualization application, which could reduce prompt tokens. The primary publisher body could not be retrieved, and the abstract emphasizes task accuracy rather than measured token/latency/cost savings; scope fit remains weak.

records.title: Training Plug-n-Play Knowledge Modules with Deep Context Distillation
records.reason: Knowledge Modules are a plausible alternative to long-context ICL/RAG, but the primary experiments compare knowledge/task accuracy and do not establish latency, memory, token, or energy savings in inference. The method also moves work into per-document module training/indexing, so net serving benefit is unresolved.
